nodes.label: Arrow Down Icon (Downward Scroll Cue)
nodes.rationale: Only non-pixel icon in the set: a smooth Bézier downward arrow (single path, no fill attribute so it inherits CSS color) on a 137x160 viewBox. Sits apart from the blocky arcade sprites because it is a UI affordance, not decoration - the smooth curves let it inherit the call-to-action button color instead of the fixed arcade palette.

nodes.label: Uncolored Inherited-Fill Silhouette Style
nodes.rationale: The arrow ships with no fill/data-color at all, so its color is decided entirely by CSS currentColor/parent. This is how one icon can serve both a light and a dark CTA without a second asset - a deliberate break from the hard-coded data-color tokens used everywhere else in the icon folder.
